interpretation.ranges: Observed minimum and maximum, not confidence intervals
interpretation.speedups: Ratios pair the same configuration and round within one machine session
interpretation.choices: Fastest median within 10% of the smallest output observed across supplied studies for this input and sink
interpretation.extension: Consider 64 workers where the median within-round 32/16 speedup exceeds 1.10; no automatic extra measurements
interpretation.stages: Stage values come from the recorded representative execution; overlapping stage times must not be added
